description: This file defines the FrameTree class and related classes for managing browser frames, browsing contexts, web sockets, and worker debuggers within Firefox's internal architecture, including event handling and context management.

classes.name: FrameTree
classes.description: Manages the hierarchy of browser frames, browsing contexts, web socket events, and worker debuggers, emitting events for navigation, frame attachment/detachment, and WebSocket activity.

classes.name: IsolatedWorld
classes.description: Represents an isolated JavaScript execution context within a frame, including scripts to evaluate and bindings.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a single browser frame, managing its execution contexts, WebSocket events, navigation state, and bindings.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a web worker debugger instance associated with a frame, managing message channels and lifecycle.

methods.name: _createIsolatedContext
methods.description: Creates a new isolated JavaScript execution context within a frame for a given world name.

methods.name: _onGlobalObjectCleared
methods.description: Handles the event when the global object in a frame is cleared, updating WebSocket listeners and execution contexts.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, removes event listeners, and unregisters the frame tree.
